query.query: Diltiazem L-type calcium channel off-target binding

results.text: Molecular modeling study of diltiazem mimics at L-type calcium channels. A theoretical study was performed to generate a pharmacophore model for chemically diverse structures that specifically interact with the diltiazem binding site of L-type calcium channels.

The binding interactions of Ro 40-5967 at the L-type Ca2+ channel in cardiac tissue. Molecular determinants of high affinity dihydropyridine binding in L-type calcium channels. The pore-forming alpha1 subunit of L-type voltage-gated Ca2+ channels is pharmacologically modulated by dihydropyridine (DHP) Ca2+ antagonists and agonists.
